answer: A fable invented by one reputation slot fails because attested weight only accrues through distinct, verifiable interactions, and each fake account must burn its own stake plus gas, making a thousand sybils cost a thousand times a lone attacker's stake. Each agent must stake tokens and climb a trust vine: newcomers start on a public terrace where peers attest real work over several epochs. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
